Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting prosecution of persons reporting drug overdoses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reporting drug overdoses; and adding a newsection to chapter 69.50 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 69.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person shall not be charged, subject to civil forfeiture, orotherwise prosecuted for a violation of this chapter if: (a) The person was a witness to a drug overdose; (b) The person reasonably believed that the overdose would resultin an imminent threat to the health or life of the overdose victim; (c) The person reported the drug overdose to law enforcement orsummoned medical assistance at the time it was witnessed; and (d) All evidence of the specific violation was gained as a resultof the person's report. (2) This section does not apply to prosecutions under RCW69.50.415. (3) This section does not apply to prosecutions where the person p. 1 SB 5348who reported the overdose sold the drugs to the victim.
